62
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 8, 2005/Sravana 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development;
Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Status of expelled Members
*201. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain
eventualities such as expulsion of Members
from political parties have not been
provided for in the Tenth Schedule of the
Constitution; and
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to bring in any amendment
in this regard?
Cultural complex in Tamil Nadu
*202. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have not chosen Tamil Nadu for setting up
of Multi-purpose cultural complex as the
Tamil region has been one of the very old
settlements in the world having thousands
of temples;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of the multi-purpose
cultural complexes sanctioned so far in the
country; and
(d) the details of the multi-purpose
cultural complexes proposed by
Government?
Wakf Board's claim on heritage
monuments
†*203. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether certain Wakf Boards have
claimed their rights on certain heritage sites,
monuments and places, on the pretext of
existence of religious symbols like mosque,
graves and prayer leading to an atmosphere
of widespread reaction and concern in the
country;
(b) if so, the steps and legal remedies
Government propose against such baseless,
irresponsible and unconstitutional claims;
and
(c) the justification for existence of
religious Wakf Boards in a democratic
secular country and the alternative

63
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
arrangement proposed by Government for
maintenance of the religious places and wakf
estates in the event of winding up of such
religious Wakf Boards?
Recognition as backward classes
†*204. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Commission
for Backward Classes examines all the
applications for granting recognition as
backward classes; and
(b) if so, the number of applications
received so far and those pending with the
Commission at present, State-wise?
FM radio policy phase II
*205. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government implemented
the policy of phase II of FM radio;
(b) if so, the number of the cities brought
under the new phase;
(c) the number of the frequencies of
1st phase which have been activated and
the reasons, if any, for the unsustainability
thereof; and
(d) whether Government have
permitted the private radios to broadcast
news and other current affairs programmes?
States share in Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan
†*206. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Governments are not contributing their
share of 25 per cent for the Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan sponsored by Government;
(b) if so, the States which had not given
their contribution for the programme during
the last three years; and
(c) the contribution from all the States
during the last five years under this
programme, year-wise?
Irregularities in Mid-Day Meal
Scheme
*207. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
irregularities such as pilferage, manipulation
of the record of delivery and utilisation of
ration and funds etc., have been brought
out by media recently in the current state
of Mid-Day Meal Scheme in Government
run primary schools;
(b) if so, the details of the irregularities
detected and the remedial measures taken/
proposed to be taken in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in most
of the schools, the teachers, instead of
teaching, are cooking the mid-day meal; and
(d) if so, the remedial steps taken in
this regard?

64
Non-utilization of funds for Higher
Education
*208. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the schemes
for higher education are suffering due to
non-utilization of the available resources;
(b) the funds allocated to the State
Government/NGOs during the last three
years indicating the details of the funds
lying unspent with them; and
(c) the measures taken by Government
to ensure cent per cent ut

321
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 8, 2005/Sravana 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development;
Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of arts and culture
1419. SHRI N. R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the achievements made by
Government towards promotion and
development of arts and culture;
(b) the achievements made and the
activities undertaken by Government
through cultural centres both in the country
and abroad during each of the last three
years;
(c) whether Government have set up
Cultural Resources and Training Centres
for foreigners; and
(d) if so, the details of the functions
and objectives thereof and achievements
made by them?
Heritage sites and monuments
†1420. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the detailed list of the heritage sites
and monuments under Government's
control;
(b) the measures taken for their
maintenance and security; and
(c) the action taken by Government on
destruction of a number of heritage sites,
monuments and statues in Rampur district
of Uttar Pradesh?
Heritage monuments in Karnataka
1421. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of heritage monuments
identified in Karnataka;
(b) the number of those managed by the
Archaeological Survey of India;
(c) whether it is a fact that the State has
no comprehensive heritage legislation to
regulate unauthorized encroachments and
urbanizations in such areas; and
(d) whether any proposal is under
Government's consideration to introduce
any legislation to regulate and preserve such
monuments of historical importance?

322
Tricentenary anniversary of Gur-Ta-
Gaddi
1422. SHRI R. S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Maharashtra has requested
for grant-in-aid from the Prime Minister
Fund/Central Government for Tricentenary
Anniversary of Gur-Ta-Gaddi at Nanded
city;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's response thereto?
Culture of Tamil Nadu
1423. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have made any
initiatives to safeguard and promote culture
of Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
achievements made in this regard
including the amount allocated for the
purpose; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Remnants of an ancient civilisation in
Amreli
1424. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that remnants
of an ancient civilisation have emerged
in Amreli district as the waters of
Shetrunji river receded after the recent
floods; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Sirpur Archaeological Complex
1425. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 1500 year
old city, complete with a palace, temples,
houses and Buddhist educational centre big
enough to accommodate 10,000 students
has been discovered at Sirpur, in
Chhattisgarh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is a fact that the Sirpur
Archaeological Complex is almost four
times as big as Nalanda?
Setting up of science city
1426. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of science cities set up/
proposed to be set up in the country
together with its aim and scope;
(b) whether all the States would be
covered under this scheme so as to have
cross-cultural interactions through these
science cities; and
(c) the funds allocated for this purpose
during the current year?
Implementation of project schemes
for NER
1427. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the major scheme being
undertaken/proposed to be undertaken by
the North Eastern Council (NEC) in NER
during the Tenth Five Year Plan period
sector-wise;

323
(b) whether the NEC has deviced a fool
proof mechanism to evaluate, monitor and
ascertain progress of the implementation
of such schemes in the region; and
(c) the role of the State Governments in
finalisation and implementation of such
projects?
Revival of Braithwaite and Company
Ltd.
1428. SHRI DIPANKAR MUKHER-
JEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Board for
Reconstruction of Public Sector Enterprises
has approved revival plan of the
Braithwaite and Company Ltd.;
